item.title: Club 3090 updates multi-engine LLM serving with new model configs
item.description:
Club 3090 updates multi-engine LLM serving with new model configs

The Club 3090 project has updated its community recipes for serving large language models on NVIDIA GPUs, expanding support for new model configurations and inference engines. This update introduces specific setups for Qwen and Gemma models while maintaining a model-agnostic approach across various hardware classes.
